CustomField.description: Created to identify a certain cohort of clients that are defined as “microenterprise". SAL-2793
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Please indicate the type of customer as defined by the Payment Services Directive -Small Charity: A small charity is one with an annual income of less than £1 million. -Micro-enterprise: An enterprise whose annual turnover and/or balance sheet total does not exceed €2 million (or sterling equivalent) and employs fewer than 10 people -Entity: A legal entity that is not a Small Charity or Micro-enterprise
CustomField.label: Customer Type
